full/powershell/opencode/ollama-embed/or.html: # Keep generated configuration files out of version control. if (-not (Test-Path .gitignore)) { New-Item -ItemType File -Path .gitignore | Out-Null } Add-Content -Path .gitignore -Value '.chunkhound.json' # Configure ChunkHound with Ollama embeddings and OrcaRouter for research. Embedding and LLM providers are independent — either works without the other. Field details: https://chunkhound.ai/docs/configuration/ # You'll need: OrcaRouter API key @' { "embedding": { "provider": "openai", "model": "qwen3-embedding", "base_url": "http://localhost:11434/v1" }, "llm": { "provider": "orcarouter", "model": "qwen/qwen3.7-flash", "api_key": "<YOUR_ORCAROUTER_API_KEY>" } } '@ | Set-Content -Path '.chunkhound.json' -Encoding utf8 # Configure OpenCode to connect to ChunkHound via MCP. if (Test-Path 'opencode.json') { Write-Host @' opencode.json already exists — merge this block into it manually: { "mcp": { "ChunkHound": { "type": "local", "command": [ "chunkhound", "mcp" ] } } } '@ } else { @' { "mcp": { "ChunkHound": { "type": "local", "command": [ "chunkhound", "mcp" ] } } } '@ | Set-Content -Path 'opencode.json' -Encoding utf8 }
